summary:
FloCafe is an open-source point-of-sale app for cafes and restaurants, here set up as the "Juniper & Rye Coffee House" store. I signed in as the owner with email and password and saved 5 views. All 5 matched the original screens when replayed.
1. pos-register: the main POS screen at /pos, with the product grid, category filter buttons and the cart panel. To get here, the steps add an Americano to the cart through its options dialog. A click on "Extra shot" in that dialog did nothing and is still in the steps, but it doesn't affect the screen.
2. dashboard: the daily dashboard at /dashboard, with sales figure cards, cost and margin numbers, recent orders and top products.
3. orders: the Orders screen at /orders, with status tabs, the list of active orders, and the full details of order ORD-0012 (items, add-ons, totals, Checkout and Add Item buttons).
4. inventory: the supplies table at /inventory, with tabs, filters, low-stock badges and row actions.
5. settings: the Store Details form at /settings, with the grouped settings menu on the left.
Not captured: the KDS sidebar link only opens a Kitchen Display page inside Settings (pairing QR codes), not a kitchen screen, so the actual kitchen display wasn't reached. Products, Customers, Staff, Expenses and Tables were left out because they look much like the inventory table and settings form. The POS add-on options dialog was skipped in favour of the POS screen with an item in the cart.
